sections.Profile:
Kings & Queens , released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in March 1965, is a one-player electro-mechanical game with a playing-card theme, designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. A row of four relay kick-out holes runs across the middle of the playfield, each passing the ball on to the next, and Gottlieb built 2,875.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1965
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
